title: The AI Music Revolution: Creativity, Controversy, and Collaboration
description: Explores AI's role in music creation, from composition to production, addressing creativity, ethics, and collaboration.
short_description: A no-hype introduction to AI in music, built around real applications, limits, and better judgement.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A practical overview of AI in music for creators, producers, editors, and readers tracking how tools reshape creative work.
